sara: T-20 — Quiet corridor engaged. Locking merges, final pin/unpin checks. Please confirm rollback owners and smoke status.
ben: Confirmed. Can confirm canary pinned to prod-canary -> v2.3.1. No further pins needed from my side.
deploy-bot: canary pin applied by @ben at 1708502400. Command: `/deploy pin prod-canary v2.3.1` — status: SUCCESS.

ben: Standby for rollback. DB migration check: migration `202403_acceptance` is backward compatible; feature flag gated.
sara: Freeze window starts now — no merges until post-launch. Customer Success has been notified. @mike hold CS channel for escalations.
mike: On it, opening a short thread in #support-oncall and pinging CS leads.
deploy-bot: Starting final warmup: 5 instances prewarmed for prod-canary. Logs: `/var/log/deploy/1708502468-warmup.log` — warmup progress: 5/5.
alice: If embeddings still fail on canary, fallback = use cached embeddings + delay embeddings rollout behind feature flag. Keep core traffic flowing. :crossed_fingers:
maria: Will attempt cache-fallback now and re-run embeddings smoke, ETA ~3m.
ben: Adding quick rollback helper to ops-runbook: `scripts/rollback_canary.sh --target v2.3.0` (manual, needs alice + ben approval).
sara: Thx — locking this in. Last check: everyone ack that rollback owners/commands are clear?
alice: ack.
ben: ack.
maria: ack, will update with smoke result.
mike: ack, CS on standby.
